contextTruncation.issue: z.ai silently truncates context to 137k tokens (vs advertised ~200k+)
contextTruncation.impact: Initial messages get dropped when context fills - can lose system prompts or early conversation
contextTruncation.recommendation: Keep context under 130k tokens, consolidate knowledge before reaching limit

mitigation.solution: PCT=90 (invariant context-window v6.0.0 : PCT >= 90, jamais bas - boucle #502/#736) + window=140k. Trigger auto-compact a 126k tokens, sous la reco 130k (#1152). Le pourcentage bas n'est plus le mecanisme : la fenetre fait le travail.
